evidence.observation: Pressure 3.05 Torr, at the ramp baseline (~3.04).
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.49 Torr, about 15% above baseline and far beyond the ~0.02 Torr noise.
Ar flow steady at ~99-100 sccm, so the gas feed has not increased.
Exhaust O2 stays at 4-6 ppm with no rise, which argues against an air leak through a seal.
Temperature holds at 750 °C with normal heater power, so thermal control looks fine.
